meanings.note: Drawing attention.

examples.trans: I can see the toy car.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

встать.gloss: to stand up, to get up

meanings.en: to stand up, to get up (out of bed)

examples.text: Кто первый встал, того и тапки.
examples.trans: First come, first served (whoever got up first gets the slippers).

examples.text: Юля, встала и пошла мыть посуду!
examples.trans: Yulia, get up and go wash the dishes!

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'you (polite or plural)' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to speak, to say, to talk', paired with 'сказать'.
Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to speak, to say, to talk', paired with 'сказать'.
+ dative of person + accusative of thing
+ infinitive: не даёт мне готовить
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

meanings.note: In one direction, now. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to go (on foot)', paired with 'пойти'.
To run for a second term. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to go (on foot)', paired with 'пойти'.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Пьяный за рулём врезался в общество слепых! В инвалидов!
examples.trans: Drunk at the wheel, he crashed into the Society for the Blind! Into disabled people!

examples.text: В доме есть пандус для инвалидов.
examples.trans: The building has a ramp for disabled people.

meanings.note: + genitive plural: много дел.
Comparative.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'we' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'много').

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

examples.text: Мы даём вам ещё немного времени.
examples.trans: We are giving you a little more time.

отдохнуть.gloss: to have a rest; to relax

meanings.note: To relax, take a break.
To take time off.

examples.trans: You need to have a proper rest at home.

examples.text: Иди уже скорее домой, пора хорошенько отдохнуть.
examples.trans: Go home already quickly, it is time to have a good rest.

examples.text: Ложись спать, тебе надо хорошо отдохнуть.
examples.trans: Go to sleep, you need to rest well.

meanings.note: With verbs: очень люблю. Core Russian adv meaning 'very, very much' in everyday speech.
With verbs: очень люблю. Core Russian adv meaning 'very, very much' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Irregular plural повара.

examples.text: Есть такой английский повар. Я по его передачам научусь готовить.
examples.trans: There is this English chef. I will learn to cook from his shows.

examples.text: Я хочу работать поваром в ресторане.
examples.trans: I want to work as a cook in a restaurant.

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine
as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.text: Правда, Нин, всё нормально. Скажи что-нибудь, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Honestly, Nina, everything's fine. Say something, please.

meanings.note: Informal: family and friends.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: On foot, once. Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to come, to arrive', paired with 'приходить'.

examples.trans: Security will be here any moment.

examples.text: Не надо, Самсон. Сейчас придёт охрана.
examples.trans: Don't, Samson. Security will be here any second.

meanings.note: 'это просто' = it's easy. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.
Это просто = it's easy. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

examples.text: У вас тут в провинции одни профессионалы.
examples.trans: You've got nothing but professionals out here in the provinces.

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: The г sounds like в.

examples.text: Виктор Степанович, сегодня никак не могу.
examples.trans: Viktor Stepanovich, I really can't today.

meanings.en: to get tired, to be tired
meanings.note: Russian past 'я устал(а)' = English 'I'm tired'

examples.trans: She is very tired after work.

examples.text: Самсон, я устал. Мне сегодня ещё в суд идти!
examples.trans: Samson, I'm tired. I still have to go to court today!

meanings.note: instrumental of утро used as an adverb

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.
